title: Armenia’s AI Bet Is Not Chip Manufacturing. It Is Compute Sovereignty
summary: Armenia, a small and lesser-known nation, is pursuing a strategic AI approach focused on compute sovereignty rather than competing in expensive chip manufacturing. The country aims to establish independent control over AI computing infrastructure rather than becoming a consumer of foreign AI products like OpenAI or video editing tools.
problem_solved: How smaller nations can achieve technological independence in the AI era without competing in capital-intensive semiconductor manufacturing.
why_valuable: It provides a practical model for smaller nations to participate in the AI revolution through compute sovereignty strategies instead of expensive hardware manufacturing.
